name: visa-requirements

vocabulary.visa_free: No authorisation required before boarding or on arrival.
vocabulary.eta: Electronic travel authorisation. Cheap and fast, but checked at check-in exactly as a visa is.
vocabulary.evisa: A visa applied for online before departure, with a fee and a real possibility of refusal.
vocabulary.visa_on_arrival: The visa is issued at the border.
vocabulary.visa_required: A visa must be obtained in advance from an embassy, consulate or application centre.
vocabulary.no_admission: Holders of this passport are not admitted for tourism.

max_stay_days_note: Null means the entitlement exists but no duration is published - often set by the officer at the border. It does not mean zero and it does not mean unlimited.
scope: Ordinary passports, tourism, single entry, direct arrival, no transit. Not diplomatic or service passports. Not business, study, work, medical or crew travel. Not residence permits. Not airside transit.
